notes: hvlgroup.com is the shared group catalogue for all house brands (Hudson Valley Lighting, Mitzi, Troy, Corbett, Schoolhouse, Sonneman, CSL). The site does NOT split its category tree by house brand - brand is only a filter (/Products/Brand/...), so the tree is extracted once as the site presents it under the mega-menu headings 'Decorative Lighting' and 'Textiles & Furnishings > Decor'. Every qty is the listing header the site prints above the grid ('<name> Filters N Products'); verified exact by full enumeration on the small categories (Mirrors 26 tiles = 26, Lamp Shades 9 = 9, Decorative Accessories 15 = 15, Outdoor Flush Mounts 15 = 15, Rechargeable Sconces 4 = 4) and by pagination on a larger one (Floor Lamp page1 60 tiles + page2 28 tiles = 88 = header). Page size is 60. Counts are SKU/finish-variant level, which is what the site itself reports. Overlap note: the menu's OUTDOOR group is the ?sub=Exterior filtered slice of the same type categories, so Outdoor Sconces (443) is a subset of Sconces (2644), Outdoor Flush Mounts (15) of Flush Mounts (555), etc.; the five outdoor rows sum to 604 vs the site's 'Exterior' umbrella total of 603. They are kept because the site presents them as their own menu entries. Deduped: /Products/Category/Trays returns the identical 15 SKUs as /Products/Category/Decorative-Accessories, so only the latter is kept. Excluded per brief: the entire 'Architectural Lighting' menu (Recessed 17, Downlights, Cylinders, Surface/Wall Mounted, Bezels, CSL/Sonneman spec systems), Bulbs, Catalogs/Finish swatches, Hardware (Pulls, Knobs, Hooks & Shelves, Bath Hardware), Furniture (Tables, Seating, Bar Cart, Storage, Beds), Textiles (Bedding, Rugs 182, Throw Pillows, Shower Curtains), Utility & Organization, and the generic /Products/Category/Decor bucket (125) which is mostly pillows/hooks/shelves. Bath & Vanity is included because the site files it under Decorative Lighting > Wall as 'Bath & Vanity Sconces'.
